items.title: Pay utility cost balance (Nachzahlung)
items.quote: Wir bitten um Zahlung der Nachforderung bis zum 08.01.2027.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date for payment: 08.01.2027. Per the rule that a printed calendar date is the due date as written, no further calculation or weekend/holiday adjustment is applied.

items.title: Raise objections (Einwendungen) to the utility cost statement
items.quote: Einwendungen gegen diese Abrechnung teilen Sie uns bitte schriftlich mit.
items.computation: The letter itself gives no explicit deadline for objections, only inviting the tenant to notify them in writing. Under German tenancy law (§ 556 Abs. 3 Satz 5 BGB), a tenant must raise objections to a Betriebskostenabrechnung at the latest by the end of the twelfth month after receipt (Zugang) of the statement, otherwise the objection right is excluded (Ausschlussfrist), unless the delay is not the tenant's fault. The letter was delivered by messenger ('Zustellung durch Boten') on 18 November 2026 at 11:05, within normal delivery hours, so Zugang = 18.11.2026. Twelve months after the month of receipt (November 2026) is November 2027; the statutory period ends at the close of that twelfth month, i.e. 30.11.2027. That date is a Tuesday, so no weekend/holiday shift under § 193 BGB is required.

warnings: The 12-month objection deadline (30.11.2027) is not stated in the letter itself; it is derived from the statutory rule in § 556 Abs. 3 Satz 5 BGB based on the stated delivery date, so double-check the actual receipt date if the messenger delivery claim is disputed.
